findings.title: Recent items change copy, labels and colour coding between desktop and the deck
findings.expected: One item reads the same at every width
findings.fix: Desktop: LATEST PROJECT, a long description, a meta line, every label teal, no arrow. Deck: PROJECT, a different one-liner, no meta, only PROJECT teal, an arrow. Pick one label set, one description and one colour rule, and give desktop rows the arrow

findings.expected: WCAG 2.5.7 single-pointer alternative to dragging, 2.1.1 keyboard scroll, 4.1.2 names for GitHub and LinkedIn
findings.fix: Make the 01 / 03 arrow real previous/next buttons, keep the deck a focusable scroll region, name each icon link. Unverified: confirm on the built page
